title: Question answering over your own notes
whyItMatters: A small **retrieval** project teaches chunking, ranking and grounding on text you know well, so wrong answers are easy to spot.
howToStart:
1. Export a handful of fictional notes as Markdown.
2. Split them into passages and index them with keyword search first.
3. Add vectors only where keyword search misses.

title: A calendar agent with two tools
whyItMatters: Two tools are enough to practise tool selection, argument validation and recovering from a failed call.
howToStart: Start with a read-only `list_events` tool and add `create_event` behind a confirmation step.

title: A regression suite for one prompt
whyItMatters: Twenty labelled examples and a pass threshold turn prompt changes from guesswork into measurements.
